description: Procedural Op Pattern (POP) geometry generator: build a SOP chain inside a Geometry COMP — primitive (box/sphere/tube/torus/grid/line/text) → Transform SOP (translate/rotate/scale) → optional Subdivide SOP → optional per-point Noise SOP displacement → Material SOP (Constant MAT) → Null SOP — then render through a Camera + Light + Render TOP to a Null TOP. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes a RotateY control; NoiseAmount + NoisePeriod are exposed only when noise_amount > 0 (otherwise the Noise SOP is omitted and those knobs would be inert). Use build_sop_geometry for a fully declarative SOP chain without a render rig; use create_3d_scene for instanced primitives, create_pbr_scene for PBR shading.

base_name.description: Optional base name for the container (defaults to 'pop_geometry'). Final container path is `<parent_path>/<base_name>` with TD's auto-suffix.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose live knobs on the container: RotateY always, plus NoiseAmount + NoisePeriod only when noise_amount > 0 (otherwise the Noise SOP is omitted and exposing the knobs would be inert).

noise_amount.description: Displacement amount of the per-point Noise SOP (0 = bypassed; ~0.1..1 typical for organic warp).

noise_period.description: Spatial period of the displacement noise. Larger = wider/softer ripples; smaller = tighter detail.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the POP geometry container is created (default '/project1').

primitive.description: Base geometry primitive. Each maps to its stock SOP (boxSOP/sphereSOP/tubeSOP/torusSOP/gridSOP/lineSOP/textSOP).

rotate.description: Rotation [rx,ry,rz] in degrees applied via the same Transform SOP.

scale.description: Per-axis scale [sx,sy,sz] applied via the same Transform SOP. [1,1,1] = unchanged.

subdivisions.description: Optional subdivision count. When > 0 a Subdivide SOP runs after the Transform SOP at this depth, then a per-point Noise SOP works on the denser mesh.

text_string.description: When `primitive` is 'text', the string fed into the textSOP. Ignored for other primitives.

translate.description: Translation [tx,ty,tz] applied via a Transform SOP after the primitive.

name: create_pop_geometry
title: Create POP geometry
